metadataAttributes.title: PM-2026-047: checkout-api latency from CPU throttling
metadataAttributes.fix: Raised the container CPU limit from 500m to 1500m and the request from 250m to 500m, and the HPA maxReplicas from 6 to 10. The throttling ratio (cfs_throttled_periods / cfs_periods) dropped from 0.78 to under 0.05.
